contexts.text: Famine, etc. () = penalties of profanation.
To draw out the soul to the hungry () = the goods of charity in general. ( = one who longs to be instructed in the truths of faith. AC 9050:7.)
There was a famine in the Land () = a scarcity of Knowledges. AC 1460:2, Illustrated. AC 1464. AC 3316:4. AC 3353:end. AC 3364. AC 3708:7.
Famine relates to vastation as to celestial things. AC 2799:7. AC 2851:6.
The hungry soul () = those who long for Knowledges. ( = a longing for good. AC 2930:4.)
A famine in the city () = that nothing of faith was left.
Hunger = the appetite, longing, and thus the affection of imbuing good. Explained.
Some (of those who are being instructed by the Lord in truths and led to good) are called the hungry.
A famine in the Land because there was no rain () = the vastation of truth in the Church.
The seven years of famine () are of the following state, when there is nothing of good in scientifics, except what is from the Divine Celestial of the Spiritual...
Shall be seven years of famine () = the apparent failure and privation of truth.
There shall arise seven years of famine after them () = the following states, when there is a failure of truth. AC 5279.
A famine = a failure of the Knowledges of good, thus a failure of truth. AC 5300.
The seven years of famine, and the support then from the collections of food = a state of regeneration by means of truths adjoined to good which were stored up in the interiors.
This takes place in the state which is signified by the seven years of famine.
Under Desolate, see this reference. AC 5360. AC 5360:end. AC 5362. AC 5369. AC 5372. AC 5376. AC 5376:2. AC 5415. AC 5576. AC 6110. AC 6144.

Carry provision for the famine of your houses () = that in the desolation of truth in which they were, they were at liberty to take counsel for themselves... Famine = failure of Knowledges, and desolation. AC 5462:end. AC 5536:3.
Famine in the Spiritual World is not famine for food... but is famine for such food as nourishes their minds...

When this food has ceased in use, hunger again ensues. In the Spiritual World, this hunger, which is want of spiritual things, is the evening... They come into this evening, or spiritual hunger, in order that they may long for truths and goods; for when these are hungered for, they yield better nourishment, as material food does to a hungry person.
Famine () = a failure of good. AC 6079.
When this spiritual food is wanting to Angels, they are in... hunger.
Famine = a failure of good and of Knowledges. References.
Famine = desolation.
In temptation, man is in hunger for good, and thirst for truth. AC 8352:3.
In the Word are mentioned four kinds of vastations and punishments... Famine = the vastation of good and the punishment of evil. AC 7102:4, Illustrated.
A famine () = a failure of the Knowledges of truth and good.
To kill this whole congregation with hunger () = that they would expire from the failure of delight and of good... Famine, here, = a failure of the good of pleasures.
A great famine over all the Land () = the vastation of the external Church; for a famine = the failure and desolation of truth and good. References.
Not a famine of bread, nor a thirst for water, but of hearing the words of Jehovah () = scarcity and failure of the Knowledges of good and truth.

The seven years of famine ()... By famine is signified a failure and scarcity of the goods and truths which are of faith and love; for these are signified by the bread, food, wheat, barley, oil, and wine which fail while the famine lasts.
Famine () = evils of life.

Famine = the deprivation and rejection of the Knowledges of truth and good which originate from evils of life. It also = ignorance of the Knowledges of truth and good which originates from their failure in the Church. And it also = a longing to know and understand them. Illustrated. AE 386, Illustrated.
Famine, when mentioned in the Word, = the destruction of spiritual life by means of evils. AE 386:7. Illustrated.
Famine () = the deprivation of the understanding of all truth. ( = when there is mere evil and falsity. AE 1125.)
Famine within the city () = the failure of all truth in doctrine.
Famine = a failure of the Knowledges of truth and good. AE 315:6. AE 734:24.
Famine and pestilence = a failure and consumption of truths.
Those who are hungry and thirsty = those who long to know good and truth. AE 257:3. AE 295:11. AE 730:25.
Famine = the deprivation of the good of love... through falsity.
Famine = the deprivation and failure of truth.
Famine = the deprivation, failure, ignorance, and at the same time desire of Knowledges. AE 654:16. AE 654:66.
One who is hungry = one who longs for good. AE 750:11.
Such as are for the famine, to the famine () = that those who reject truths perish through falsities.
I will kill thy root with famine, and it shall kill thy remnant () = that all truths, from their primes to their ultimates, will perish through falsities.
